text.en:
The National Program for Unification and Development Council established
under Executive Order No. 152 dated January 21, 1994 is hereby placed directly under the Office
of the Executive Secretary.
The National Program for Unification and Development Council established for
the purpose shall now be composed of the folowing:
a. The Executive Secretary
b. The Secretary of the Interior and Local Government
c. The Secretary of National Defense
d. The Secretary of Social Welfare and Development
e. The Presidential Adviser on the Peace Process
The Secretary concerned, in case of incapacity, illness, or other justifiable reasons, may
be represented in the Council by his senior undersecretary.
Executive Order No. 152 dated January 21, 1994. as amended,
amended accordingly.
Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this ill
tday of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen
hundred and ninety-four.
